result.title: SimOPD: Relational Knowledge Transfer for On-Policy Distillation
result.summary: A key challenge in on-policy distillation (OPD) is extracting effective supervision from teacher knowledge. Supervision from token probabilities may underutilize internal knowledge, while direct hidden-state matching forces the student to shift to the teacher's feature space and complicates cross-architecture transfer. Inspired by contrastive learning's use of relationships between instances, we propose \textbf{SimOPD} to transfer teacher internal knowledge through response similarities. Specifically, SimOPD uses paired memory banks of student-generated responses to extract supervision from the teacher's internal representations as similarity distributions. The student then matches these distributions within its own representation space, retaining representational freedom and removing the need for cross-model projection. Extensive experiments show that SimOPD improves the overall average over the strongest baselines by up to 2.6 and 3.1 percentage points in same- and cross-architecture settings.

AI.brief_summary: SimOPD 面向 on-policy 蒸馏，用学生生成回复构成的配对记忆库，从教师内部表示中提取相似度分布作为监督信号，让学生在自己的表示空间内匹配这些分布，从而避免隐藏状态直接对齐和跨架构投影。
AI.relevance_reason: 「用相似度分布间接监督内部表示、保留学生表示自由度」这一做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的训练监督与跨模型迁移提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
